prompt.en: What is the name given to the deportation of the Acadians between 1755 and 1763?
prompt.fr: Quel nom donne-t-on à la déportation des Acadiens entre 1755 et 1763?

explanation.en: During the war between Britain and France, more than two-thirds of the Acadians were deported from their homeland. That ordeal is known as the Great Upheaval, and the Acadians survived it and kept their own identity.
explanation.fr: Pendant la guerre entre la Grande-Bretagne et la France, plus des deux tiers des Acadiens ont été déportés de leur terre natale. Cette épreuve est connue sous le nom de Grand Dérangement; les Acadiens y ont survécu et ont conservé leur identité.

source.quote: Despite this ordeal, known as the “Great Upheaval,” the Acadians survived and maintained their unique identity.
